home.title: Short links you can <highlight>share and track.</highlight>
home.eyebrow: Free to use · No credit card
home.description: Turn long, messy URLs into clean short links. Set an expiry when you need one and see how many people clicked.
home.featureFastDescription: Paste a URL, get a link that is ready to share.
home.featureExpiryDescription: Choose an end date and the link stops working on its own.
home.featureClicksDescription: See how often each link was opened.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to shorten your first link?
home.ctaDescription: Create an account and get a short link in less than a minute.
